guitar.evidence: Joe Bonamassa is famous for his large collection of vintage Gibsons (Les Pauls, ES-335s) and Fender Stratocasters; extremely well documented in guitar media.

tone.summary: A warm, mid-focused blues-rock chain using a Boost for grit, followed by an AC30 style amp and 4x12 cab, finished with Chorus, Delay, and Room reverb.
